data.long_meaning: From the Hebrew word 'heres', meaning mountain or high place. In the Bible, Herson is not a well-known name, but it may be derived from the name of various biblical mountains, such as Mount Horeb or Mount Zion. The name Herson carries the meaning “God's mountain” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Herson usually hope their child will grow to embody god's mountain and live with faith, good character and purpose.
